'''Noris''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was located within the [[Noris system/Legends|Noris system]], in the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Space]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. It was connected to the planets [[Schesa/Legends|Schesa]] and [[Sharb/Legends|Sharb]] via the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Path of the Houses]], and to the planet [[Ornfra/Legends|Ornfra]] by another [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route.<ref name="TEA" />

Noris was an outlying colony of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Species/Legends|species]], and was home to one of the [[Ruling Families/Legends|Ruling Families]] that ruled over the Chiss Ascendancy, the government of the Chiss. At some point before [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], Noris's resident Ruling Family employed hives of the sentient [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] as a work force. As a result, the Family fell out of power by that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] due to continued reliance on the [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] and was wiped out in a [[Chiss civil conflict|civil conflict]] against rival Ruling Families.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Noris was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the planet in grid square F-8.<ref name="TEA" />
